A = Intersect[xAxis,yAxis]
ShowLabel[A, true]
SetVisibleInView[A, 1, false]
SetColor[A, "#444444"]

B = Point[xAxis]
ShowLabel[B, true]
SetVisibleInView[B, 1, false]
SetColor[B, "#7d7dff"]
SetLabelMode[B, 0]
SetCoords[B, 10, 0]

f = Segment[A,B]
ShowLabel[f, false]
SetVisibleInView[f, 1, true]
SetLabelMode[f, 0]
SetLineThickness[f, 2]

C = (5, 3)
ShowLabel[C, true]
SetVisibleInView[C, 1, false]
SetColor[C, "#0000ff"]
SetLabelMode[C, 0]

g = Segment[B,C]
ShowLabel[g, false]
SetVisibleInView[g, 1, true]
SetLabelMode[g, 0]
SetLineThickness[g, 2]

h = Segment[C,A]
ShowLabel[h, false]
SetVisibleInView[h, 1, true]
SetLabelMode[h, 0]
SetLineThickness[h, 2]

poly1 = Polygon[A,C,B]
SetLineThickness[poly1, 2]
ShowLabel[poly1, false]
SetVisibleInView[poly1, 1, true]
SetColor[poly1, "#993300"]
SetLabelMode[poly1, 0]

D = PointIn[poly1]
ShowLabel[D, true]
SetVisibleInView[D, 1, true]
SetColor[D, "#7d7dff"]
SetLabelMode[D, 0]

i = LineBisector[A,D]
ShowLabel[i, false]
SetVisibleInView[i, 1, true]
SetLabelMode[i, 0]
SetLineThickness[i, 2]

E = Intersect[i,h]
ShowLabel[E, true]
SetVisibleInView[E, 1, false]
SetColor[E, "#444444"]
SetLabelMode[E, 0]
SetPointSize[E, 3]

F = Intersect[i,f]
ShowLabel[F, true]
SetVisibleInView[F, 1, false]
SetColor[F, "#444444"]
SetLabelMode[F, 0]
SetPointSize[F, 3]

poly2 = Polygon[E,F,D]
SetLineThickness[poly2, 2]
ShowLabel[poly2, false]
SetVisibleInView[poly2, 1, true]
SetColor[poly2, "#993300"]
SetFilling[poly2, 0.1]
SetLabelMode[poly2, 0]

G = Midpoint[A,B]
ShowLabel[G, true]
SetVisibleInView[G, 1, false]
SetColor[G, "#444444"]
SetLabelMode[G, 0]
SetPointSize[G, 3]

j = Line[C,G]
ShowLabel[j, false]
SetVisibleInView[j, 1, true]
SetConditionToShowObject[j, j ≟ i]
SetColor[j, "#ff0000"]
SetLabelMode[j, 0]
